annotations.title: Pay a batch analysis charge and build

description: Step 2 of a Solana payout_batch with checks. After signing and sending payout_batch's charge.transaction, hand its signature here with the loteId and payer. The server verifies the charge on-chain, runs the paid analysis on EVERY destination, EXCLUDES any wallet that is blocked or over the payer's risk threshold (it receives nothing, its money never moved), and returns { transactions[], approved[] (each with its scan result), rejected[] (wallet, reason) }: sign each transactions[i].transaction (prepare_signing, POST to /v1/svm/execute) and call payout_report_payment with that signature and its invoiceIds. Idempotent with the same charge signature (re-returns the built batch). Errors: batch_charge_not_found, invalid_tx_hash, analysis_payment_pending (409, the network has not confirmed the charge yet, send the signature again shortly), analysis_payment_rejected (the transaction does not pay this charge), tx_already_used.

payer.description: The wallet that paid the charge (base58).

txHash.description: The Solana signature of the charge payment. Omit only to rebuild a fully-reused batch (website session only).

name: payout_charge
